visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark brown hair and a white sweatshirt sits at a wooden table in an indoor room. She smiles broadly, looking directly at the camera while holding four pink rectangular boxes featuring a cartoon white bear. Behind her are shelves filled with various figurines and a striped blind. (2) A close-up view shows a blue and white box being rotated by hands. The box features illustrations of colorful miniature store scenes on its sides. (3) The woman opens the first box, revealing a small white compact case. She opens the case to show an 'Ice Cream' shop interior and begins placing tiny colorful plastic pieces like ice cream cones and a small bear figure inside. (4) The woman holds up a second pink box and then opens a new white compact. She assembles a 'Candy Store' scene with yellow and pink elements, placing a white bunny character and candy jars on a counter. (5) In a new phase, she opens another box to reveal a yellow-themed 'Fish-shaped Bun' shop. She carefully positions small fish-shaped bread pieces and a blue-and-white cat character into the compact's slots. (6) A fourth compact is opened, showing a purple and pink 'Boutique' theme. She adds miniature hats, shoes, and a white bear character wearing a bow to the display. (7) She opens a green-themed 'Garden' shop compact. She places tiny cacti, a watering spray bottle, and a cat character into the tiered shelves within the case. (8) A red and blue themed 'Toyland' shop is assembled. She places a rocking horse, a building block, and a character with a star on its head into the scene. (9) The final box reveals a brown and yellow 'Bakery' shop. She assembles bread baskets, tongs, and a rabbit character dressed as a chef. (10) The camera pans across all eight assembled shop compacts lined up on the wooden table. The woman leans over them, making an excited face and pointing at the collection. Yellow captions appear at the bottom throughout the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a strong four-on-the-floor beat. There is a distinct sound of cardboard boxes being moved and rustled. (2) As the boxes are opened, frequent incidental noises of plastic crinkling and soft thuds are heard. The speaker's pitch rises with excitement, using many exclamations like 'Wow!' and 'So cute!'. (3) Each time a new miniature piece is placed or clicked into the compact, subtle 'pop' or 'click' SFX are occasionally added in post-production to emphasize the assembly. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (4) In the later stages of the video, the speaker's arousal increases further, bordering on shouting with joy as she reacts to the assembled toys. The music swells slightly towards the end, concluding with a final high-pitched exclamation from the speaker over the fading electronic track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Itemized Showcase (1 to 8) -> Final Group Display.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an enthusiastic unboxing and assembly showcase for a set of Chiikawa-themed blind box miniatures (Compact Shops) exclusive to Korea. The creator aims to share her excitement, show the intricate details and assembly process of each of the 8 different scenes, and ultimately recommend the collection to fans of the franchise.
